'''2004 German Open (Ralltiir)''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament in Germany (2004). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms. [[Dirk Friedrichs]]'s 2004 win is engraved on the Ralltiir Cup, the trophy of the SW CCG Germany Regionals, together with [[Chris Menzel]] (2003), Florian Siepel (2005), [[Kris Van Beurden]] (2006) and Dirk Friedrichs again (2007); Uber-Obi had the names updated in May 2008 when the cup, broken the year before, was repaired.<ref name="sf-19214-299372">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=299372#p299372 Ralltiir Regionals (Hannover/Germany)], Uber-Obi, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (4 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125174838/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19214.html Internet Archive]</ref>
